scope: All 438 DDDHD chest identities; normalized map-relative location facts and available access actions. No new collectible IDs.
coordinateConvention: Cardinal directions refer to the in-game area map, not the camera. These are pickup landmarks/location hints, not a claim of a fully narrated route from every entrance.
evidenceBoundary: 2012 map-location facts were reconciled against all current HD world/character/item/area records. HD replacement items use explicit version-marked KHWiki world rows. This does not independently certify all official Reports order, earliest story access, returnability, or movement minima. Existing longer authored approaches and current world notes must be preserved by integration.
